  • Organizar e liderar a equipe da área, promovendo uma estrutura eficiente, clara nas responsabilidades e orientada ao cumprimento das metas operacionais e técnicas.
  • Orientar a equipe na análise de cobertura, inspeções, determinação de danos e emissão de relatórios, fortalecendo decisões fundamentadas e oportunas.
  • Controlar o desenvolvimento dos processos de liquidação, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, rastreabilidade e qualidade técnica.
  • Negociar soluções técnicas em sinistros complexos, resguardando os interesses da empresa dentro dos marcos contratuais e legais.
  • Garantir conformidade nas autorizações de provisões, relatórios e comunicações com protocolos internos, requisitos regulatórios e padrões de serviço.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, analisar indicadores de desempenho e promover o desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Administrar o budget da área, planejamento estratégico, ações comerciais, controles estatísticos, criação de fluxos e scripts para padronização, acompanhamento de KPIs, NPS, produtividade, WIP, PDDs, pipeline de negócios, renovação de contratos e outros indicadores.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Direito ou áreas afins ao setor de seguros.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou diploma em Seguros Gerais, Gestão de Riscos, Responsabilidade Civil ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência no setor de seguros, especialmente em ajuste ou liquidação de sinistros de responsabilidade civil.
  • Pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica, coordenação de equipes ou funções de chefia/subgerência.
  • Experiência em contato direto com seguradoras, segurados, peritos e terceiros envolvidos.
  • Interpretação de apólices de seguros e normativas aplicáveis em responsabilidade civil.
  • Certificações ou cursos em Responsabilidade Civil, Gestão de Sinistros ou Seguros Gerais são diferenciais.

Competências desejadas

  • Liderança técnica e capacidade de coordenação de equipes especializadas.
  • Habilidade para negociação técnica em situações complexas.
  • Foco em resultados, melhoria contínua e qualidade operacional.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de indicadores e tomada de decisões.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento.

Sobre a Crawford & Company Brasil

Somos líderes globais em soluções para gestão de sinistros, presentes em mais de 70 países. Com mais de 80 anos de história e uma equipe de mais de 10.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é restaurar vidas, negócios e comunidades por meio de serviços de excelência e inovação.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.

title: Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.

Se você se identifica com nossos valores, essa é a sua chance de brilhar!

Resumo da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística para integrar nosso time. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver, validar e implementar modelos estatísticos para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos estatísticos para análise de dados e previsão de tendências.
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Validar e monitorar a performance dos modelos, garantindo sua aderência e robustez.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções estatísticas.
  • Documentar processos, resultados e apresentar insights.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de programação e softwares estatísticos para análise e modelagem.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos modelos e metodologias aplicadas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Economia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

  • Testes : unitários, integração, mocks e stubs;
  • Banco de dados : MySQL e Oracle, SQL avançado (joins, subconsultas, agregações), procedimentos armazenados, triggers, transações e isolamento;
  • Cache : Redis / Elasticache;
  • Controle de versão : Git, resolução de conflitos, pull requests;
  • Contêineres e DevOps : Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, pipelines CI/CD;
  • Monitoramento : Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog;
  • Mensageria : RabbitMQ;
  • Ferramentas de IA : conhecimento na utilização de IA para apoio ao desenvolvimento de software;
  • Metodologias ágeis : experiência com Scrum, Kanban ou similares.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com migração de sistemas e modernização de legados;
  • Vivência prévia com produtos financeiros, especialmente crédito.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:

O candidato também deve ser capaz de lidar com informações sensíveis, confidenciais e não rotineiras, estar aberto a questionar o status quo e trabalhar em uma organização em rápida transformação, ao mesmo tempo em que inspira excelência em si mesmo(a) e nos parceiros de negócios.

• Participar de um programa global de transformação de operações

• Contribuir para e comunicar os processos de negócios atuais e futuros, fluxos de dados e diagramas de processos, jornadas dos usuários e fluxos de trabalho

• Criar e manter acompanhamentos de projetos (trackers), bem como canais de comunicação para gerenciar ações de forma eficaz, cumprindo prazos enquanto trabalha em ritmo acelerado

• Avaliar e comunicar regularmente restrições e riscos dos projetos em nível global; identificar dependências, decisões estratégicas, planos de mitigação

• Recomendar soluções para melhorar a produtividade, reduzir a complexidade geral, minimizar dívidas técnicas e possibilitar uma melhor integridade de dados, apoiando pesquisas com usuários (User Research) para aprimorar a experiência do usuário (UX) do produto, atuando como defensor(a) do usuário para as equipes de Operações de Vendas / Vendas

• Estabelecer relacionamentos sólidos de trabalho com colegas de outras equipes de Operações de Vendas e parceiros multifuncionais para alcançar os objetivos

Qualificações Básicas

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de gestão, finanças, operações de vendas, operações de negócios ou em funções analíticas/operacionais

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com SFDC (Salesforce) e D365 (Dynamics 365), fluência em SQL, Power BI/Tableau e Excel

Qualificações Desejáveis

• Atenção excepcional aos detalhes: aprendizado ágil com atenção meticulosa aos detalhes e experiência comprovada em identificar pontos de falha em processos

• Experiência com escalabilidade: confortável com dados e incertezas; consegue rapidamente fazer conexões e identificar causas raiz; mergulha nos detalhes e táticas operacionais, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui com a visão estratégica e resolve problemas operacionais

• Experiência com processos e ferramentas de vendas: especialista em fluxos e processos de vendas (ex.: planejamento de headcount, construção de territórios, definição de metas, previsões), operações e ferramentas (ex.: Salesforce, Dynamics 365); experiência na implementação de sistemas de terceiros e uso de metodologias ágeis

• Comunicação clara e eficaz: traduz pensamentos e estratégias complexas em recomendações simples e acionáveis, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente, em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado por dados — inclusive com apresentações para públicos diversos

• Responsabilidade e priorização: experiência atuando com supervisão limitada no dia a dia, gerenciando múltiplas prioridades e cumprindo prazos

• Proatividade e atitude positiva: busca informações de forma independente, resolve problemas conceituais, mobiliza recursos e entrega resultados em situações desafiadoras e multifacetadas; motivado(a) e engajado(a) para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança

• Especialização em operações e fluxos de trabalho de vendas

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.

The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.

You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.

Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.

In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff

Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.

Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.

Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.

Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.

Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

We take our company values seriously: Client Results, Excellence @ Speed, Openness, and Commitment to the Success of Others.

This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo’s public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

• Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

• Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.e. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

title: Customer Succes Sr Analyst (Exclusivo soluções de prevenção à fraude )
description:
Buscamos Customer Success Analyst SR um altamente motivado e experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de Fraude. Experiência prévia com soluções de prevenção à fraude – requisito excludente.

Esta posição é fundamental para garantir uma experiência excepcional aos nossos clientes, desde a integração inicial até a manutenção de relacionamentos sólidos e a gestão de suas necessidades em prevenção de fraude e pagamentos. O candidato ideal será responsável por conduzir o processo de onboarding técnico de nossos serviços, bem como oferecer suporte e manter relações comerciais de longo prazo com cada cliente.

Local de trabalho: São Paulo/SP – Modelo híbrido (presencial 1x por semana)

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de Clientes: Manter relacionamentos sólidos e de confiança com os clientes designados, entendendo suas necessidades e atuando como o principal ponto de contato para resolver dúvidas e garantir sua satisfação contínua.
  • Onboarding e Integração: Guiar novos clientes no processo de integração técnica de nossas soluções de fraude e pagamentos, garantindo que todos os requisitos sejam atendidos e que a implementação seja bem-sucedida.
  • Treinamento de Clientes: Oferecer treinamentos às equipes dos clientes para garantir o uso eficiente de nossas ferramentas e serviços de fraude e pagamentos, maximizando o valor da solução.
  • Análise de Desempenho e Acompanhamento: Realizar análises periódicas do desempenho das soluções implementadas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e ajustando estratégias conforme as necessidades dos clientes.
  • Interação com Equipes Internas: Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de produto, suporte e desenvolvimento para resolver problemas técnicos e gerenciar melhorias que beneficiem os clientes.
  • Atualização e Relatórios: Manter os clientes informados sobre novidades e melhorias nos produtos, além de apresentar relatórios periódicos sobre a eficácia e os resultados das soluções.

Requisitos

  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos em funções de Account Management, Customer Success ou similares em empresas de tecnologia, preferencialmente em fintech, pagamentos ou prevenção de fraude.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em tecnologia e processos de integração por API; experiência com soluções de pagamento e antifraude será altamente valorizada.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados e gerar insights que ajudem os clientes a maximizar os benefícios das soluções.
  • Proatividade, orientação ao cliente e habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas.
  • Nível avançado de inglês (desejável), uma vez que trabalhará com clientes de língua hispana e internacional.

Benefícios

  • Plano médico e odontológico - queremos você cheio de saúde e sorridente!
  • Convênio Farmácia - sabe aquela gripe quando a coisa aperta no fim do mês? Aqui você compra remédios e desconta na folha!
  • Horário Flexível - confiamos em sua organização e bom senso com suas responsabilidades.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
The Integration Solution Architect (SA) role resides within the Ant International Pre-sale Integration Solution team and is responsible for leading key strategic activities such as Integration Solution Architecture creation and presentation as well as projects' implementation and maintenance.

The SA routinely creates and presents multi-platform / multi-team Solution Architectures and estimates and so must be able to maintain good working relationships with business facing as well as technical constituents across multiple teams and Business Units. This role provides leadership for quality focused activities such as requirements Integration Detail reviews, Technical Design reviews, Test Plan reviews, and Impact Analysis reviews. Working closely with the BD and PD team, the SA role consistently works to assure that any new Integration being done appropriately with the internal/external teams aligns with direction, best practices, and standards defined.

Finally, the SA must stay abreast of industry technology trends and direction as it relates to the Fintech and be able to present applicable advances and changes to help drive future looking initiatives.

NICE TO HAVE

  • the multiple language skills

  • Fintech/Payment business background and experience are highly appreciated

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Formação em Corretor de Seguros
description:
Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Finance Project Analyst will act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • As a Project Financial Analyst, you will record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • 1-3 years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Key Account Manager
description:

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs.

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America.

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job

We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.

What is CORNER Renovation?

CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.

Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

Requirements:

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent/Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max/Corona is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.
  • Develop kitchen and other space designs based on details collected from clients.
  • Conduct online meetings with new and existing clients to understand their requirements.
  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.
  • Provide guidance on efficient kitchen layouts, including the selection of storage solutions.
  • Review technical drawings and orders before production.
  • Assist in selecting appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
  • Communicate with the internal team to ensure alignment across project details, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project, ensuring clear communication, smooth process, and an excellent client experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Professional growth and experience working with international clients
  • Flexible vacation and holiday schedule
  • Company covers 50% of course costs

Looking to work for a fast-growing startup with great career opportunities? We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are ready to work hard, and eager to learn and develop their skills.

After you apply, we will review your application. If it meets our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the details and schedule an interview.

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Java Stack)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused On-Site Technical Support Engineer to provide technical expertise for our financial services products, with a focus on credit industry solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong Java development skills, hands-on experience with MySQL, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in real-time. A background in the credit/banking industry and exceptional client communication skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support for the financial systems, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid resolution of issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve problems related to Java applications, Redis caching, MySQL databases, and associated middleware.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.

System Maintenance & Optimization

  • Monitor system performance, conduct regular health checks, and optimize configurations for Redis, MySQL, and Java applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to deploy patches, updates, and hotfixes in production environments.

Client Communication & Requirements Handling

  • Act as the primary technical liaison between clients and the Chinese teams, transmitting business needs to technical solution arthitect in China.
  • Respond promptly to client operational requests, prioritize tasks, and manage expectations effectively.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Create detailed technical documentation, including incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Train clients on system functionalities and operational workflows.

Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure solutions adhere to local credit industry regulations (e.g., data security, audit requirements).
  • Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to improve system reliability and user experience.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Java development and debugging (Spring Boot, J2EE, or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience with MySQL (query optimization, replication, backup/recovery).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Linux/Unix environments, and scripting (Shell/Python).
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Jenkins, Docker) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Redis (cluster management, performance tuning) is a plus.

Industry Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support or development roles, preferably within the credit, banking, or fintech sectors.
  • Understanding of credit business processes (e.g., loan management, risk assessment, payment systems).

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently for on-site client support.

Language

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in Java, Redis, MySQL, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
  • Knowledge of financial compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of credit risk management systems(e.g., FICO, Neurotech).

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager - LATAM
description:

This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.

  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.

PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE

MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:

  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Account Executive (SaaS | Contractor)
description:

title: Lubrificador Industrial
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Lubrificador Industrial para atuar no time de Confiabilidade.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Executar rotinas de lubrificação e coleta de óleo em máquinas e equipamentos conforme plano de manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas para identificar falhas, vazamentos ou anomalias relacionadas à lubrificação;
  • Controlar e registrar o consumo de óleos, graxas e outros insumos utilizados;
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos de segurança do trabalho e uso adequado de EPIs.

Quais os requisitos?

Experiência consolidada na função;

Ensino Médio Completo;

Residir em Barretos, Guaíra ou Morro Agudo.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Representante de Vendas - Exclusivo para PCD (Brasil)
description:

Chiesi Brasil

A Chiesi Brasil tem mais de 45 anos de história dedicados à produção de medicamentos de última geração, com qualidade e confiabilidade reconhecidas mundialmente. Foi a primeira afiliada da Chiesi e é atualmente entre as 10 maiores operações do Grupo. Contamos com uma planta industrial localizada em Santana de Parnaíba, que abastece o mercado interno e exporta para diversos países do Grupo, além de uma sede administrativa em São Paulo e uma Força de Campo distribuída pelo país. São mais de 400 colaboradores atuando diariamente com foco na melhora da qualidade de vida dos pacientes. Como uma empresa que vive diariamente uma cultura centrada em pessoas, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa Great Place to Work, e de ter feito parte do ranking das 20 melhores empresas de saúde para trabalhar no Brasil em 2024. Nós fomos a primeira empresa do mercado farmacêutico brasileiro a receber a certificação ISO 37001, que visa apoiar as organizações no combate à corrupção, e é mais uma demonstração da nossa forma de atuar com transparência para o mercado e a sociedade, fortalecendo nossa credibilidade junto a colaboradores, clientes e parceiros. Tudo isso graças à nossa cultura de transparência, empatia, colaboração e foco nas pessoas!

Unidade AIR

A Chiesi está totalmente comprometida com o cuidado e a melhoria da qualidade de vida de pessoas que sofrem de doenças respiratórias, incluindo asma e DPOC (Doença Pulmonar Obstrutiva Crônica).

Propósito

Desenvolver as atividades de promoção médica dos produtos da unidade de negócios Primary Care (Franquia AIR) da empresa, baseando-se nas características e benefícios demonstrados pelos estudos clínicos e conhecimentos médico-científicos, através de visitas e reuniões com médicos, clínicas, hospitais e farmácias; com o objetivo de atingir as metas estabelecidas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Visitar médicos e eventualmente profissionais de saúde em consultórios, clínicas, hospitais e serviços públicos de saúde, objetivando divulgar e promover os produtos da empresa;
  • Elaborar e executar Plano de Ação Territorial e Tático, com base nas estratégicas da empresa;
  • Promover encontros e reuniões junto aos médicos e/ou profissionais de saúde com o intuito de estimular o debate e a troca de informações médico-científicas, viabilizando uma melhor divulgação, experimentação e prescrição dos produtos da empresa;
  • Planejar e organizar o trabalho de visitação médica para melhor desenvolvimento das atividades de trabalho e bom nível de produtividade em campo, alcançando os KPIs (indicadores de performance) da empresa;
  • Manter eficiência no levantamento de dados dos médicos, hospitais, clínicas, através de coleta de informações e preparação de dados, reportando nos sistemas da empresa visando enriquecimento, atualização e acompanhamento de cadastro médico da empresa;

  • Visitar com frequência farmácias, drogarias e redes, para monitorar a demanda, estoque e ações dos produtos da empresa e da concorrência;
  • Utilizar as técnicas de Direção Defensiva na condução do veículo da empresa em todos os momentos e situações;
  • Atender as diretrizes do Código de Ética e de Conduta, Política Antissuborno e demais políticas e procedimentos do Programa de Integridade da Chiesi.

Experiência requerida

  • Formação superior completa. Preferencialmente em Administração, Comunicação, Marketing, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou afins;
  • CNH válida e disponibilidade para viagens;

title: Engineering Manager
description:

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.

  • System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  • Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  • Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

title: Webflow Developer
description:
About you

You are someone who thrives in building scalable, high-impact solutions and who seeks to influence not just technology but also the direction of the product. You’re looking for a company where innovation and ownership go hand in hand, and where your contributions directly shape outcomes.

You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 3+ years of experience in Webflow design and development.
  • Advanced JavaScript skills focused on accessibility and DOM manipulation.

A Inetum é uma empresa global de serviços de TI, reconhecida por sua agilidade, inovação e compromisso com a transformação digital. Estamos em busca de profissionais com um perfil dinâmico, que compartilhem nossa paixão por tecnologia e inovação. Se você possui excelentes habilidades de comunicação, empatia para entender as necessidades dos clientes, foco em resultados e uma visão estratégica para oferecer soluções disruptivas e de longo prazo, você será um grande diferencial para a nossa equipe.

A Inetum oferece um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com oportunidades contínuas de crescimento profissional e aprendizado.

Se você está pronto para desafiar os limites e fazer a diferença em um cenário digital em constante evolução, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

Junte-se à Inetum e seja parte de um time que está sempre à frente do seu tempo, transformando o futuro com soluções tecnológicas de ponta!

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades simples em backend (Java/Spring Boot) e frontend (Angular);
  • Apoiar integrações com serviços em nuvem (AWS) e soluções de IA;
  • Contribuir em testes, refinamentos e planejamento de sprints ágeis.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver sistemas de antifraude;
  • Apoiar definição funcional e UX, visando a melhor experiência do cliente;

Dar suporte a gestores de negócio nas definições funcionais;

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista de Métricas Pleno
description:
Analista de Métricas Pleno

Estamos em busca de um analista de métricas que será responsável por otimizar a eficiência operacional e a qualidade do atendimento, garantindo que as metas de desempenho sejam alcançadas. Eles trabalham com indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs), geram relatórios, dimensionam equipes e colaboram com outras áreas para melhorar a produtividade e a satisfação do cliente.

  • Identificar, implementar e analisar KPIs para avaliar o desempenho do atendimento ao cliente.

  • Elaborar relatórios para análise e acompanhamento dos indicadores de desempenho (Dashboard).
